race.comment: Big field but no noted leader. That should play into the hands of BRING THE THUNDER (1) with Rawiller and a good draw. Will be able to coast along close to the speed and on recent form looks the one to beat. BALGOWAN (8) is overdue for a win and also looks well placed here. Races handy and with the claim has no weight. Has won here and placed two of last four. Should be in the finish. TRUE PROPHET (2) has placed three of four runs since a win five back. Freshened for this sharper trip and might be beaten for early speed but will wind up late. ALPINOVA (6) finished hard to miss by a length last time. Close to a win and will be winding up strongly. PURE RAIN (7) is fitter for a jump-out and has placed 4/5 while fresh.
